title: 2 How the ceremoniall Lawes differ from the Morall.

segments.text: 1 CEremonies are temporarie, the Morall are perpetuall.

2 The Ceremonies are done all alike; The Morall are not doone alwaies alike. 3 The Ceremonies ſignifie; The Morall are ſignified. 4 The Morall are as the generall: The Ceremoniall are reſtrained in ſpeciall. 5 The Ceremoniall ſerue for the Morall; The Morall are the end or ſcope of the Ceremoniall.
